```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)     # For handling single-cell and pseudobulk Seurat objects
library(DESeq2)     # For differential expression analysis
library(dplyr)      # For combining and filtering results
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Aggregate raw counts per condition, sample, and cell class
pseudo_classes_KA <- AggregateExpression(
  KA_seurat_plots,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "counts",
  group.by = c("condition", "sample.origin", "classes"),
  return.seurat = TRUE
)

pseudo_classes_KA$classes_cond <- paste(
  pseudo_classes_KA$classes,
  pseudo_classes_KA$condition,
  sep = "_"
)

Idents(pseudo_classes_KA) <- pseudo_classes_KA$classes_cond

cell_classes <- unique(pseudo_classes_KA$classes)

# Store DESeq2 results and objects
de_result_classes_pseudo_DESeq2_list <- list()
dds_classes_pseudo_list <- list()
res_classes_pseudo_list <- list()

for (cell_class in cell_classes) {

  epi_id <- paste0(cell_class, "_Epi")
  control_id <- paste0(cell_class, "_Control")

  n_epi <- sum(pseudo_classes_KA$classes_cond == epi_id)
  n_control <- sum(pseudo_classes_KA$classes_cond == control_id)

  # Run DESeq2 only when there are at least two pseudobulk samples per condition
  if (n_epi > 1 && n_control > 1) {

    meta <- pseudo_classes_KA@meta.data

    epi_cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$classes_cond == epi_id]
    control_cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$classes_cond == control_id]
    cells_to_keep <- c(epi_cells, control_cells)

    counts_mat <- GetAssayData(
      pseudo_classes_KA,
      assay = "RNA",
      slot = "counts"
    )[, cells_to_keep, drop = FALSE]

    sample_info <- data.frame(row.names = cells_to_keep)
    sample_info[epi_cells, "group"] <- "Epi"
    sample_info[control_cells, "group"] <- "Control"
    sample_info$group <- factor(sample_info$group, levels = c("Control", "Epi"))
    sample_info$wellKey <- rownames(sample_info)

    dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
      countData = counts_mat,
      colData = sample_info,
      design = ~ group
    )

    dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
    dds <- estimateDispersions(dds, fitType = "local")
    dds <- nbinomWaldTest(dds)

    res <- results(
      dds,
      contrast = c("group", "Epi", "Control"),
      alpha = 0.05
    )

    res <- res[
      complete.cases(res$pvalue) &
        complete.cases(res$padj) &
        complete.cases(res$log2FoldChange),
    ]

    de_res_df <- data.frame(
      p_val = res$pvalue,
      p_adj_BH = res$padj,
      log2FC = res$log2FoldChange,
      stat = res$stat,
      baseMean = res$baseMean,
      row.names = rownames(res)
    )

    de_result_classes_pseudo_DESeq2_list[[cell_class]] <- de_res_df
    dds_classes_pseudo_list[[cell_class]] <- dds
    res_classes_pseudo_list[[cell_class]] <- res

  } else {
    message(
      "Skipping ", cell_class,
      ": not enough pseudobulk samples in one or both conditions."
    )
  }
}

# Save results
results_dir <- file.path(
  "results",
  "pseudo_differential_expression",
  "deseq2_classes_pseudo",
  as.character(Sys.Date())
)

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (cell_class in names(de_result_classes_pseudo_DESeq2_list)) {

  filename <- paste0(
    cell_class,
    "_",
    Sys.Date(),
    "_DESeq2_DE_results.csv"
  )

  full_path <- file.path(results_dir, filename)

  write.csv(
    de_result_classes_pseudo_DESeq2_list[[cell_class]],
    file = full_path,
    row.names = TRUE
  )

  message("Results for ", cell_class, " saved to: ", full_path)
}

```
